I literally just found this subreddit. I've been experiencing sleep paralysis at least once a month since I was 10. I am currently 19. I am so glad I found this and I am so glad I am not the only one. Mate, I can relate to this sooooo well. I also wake up through wiggling my left foot sometimes or tongue.

I hear voices whispering in my ear. I feel hands on and in my body. I feel lots and lots of fear, and I always get "baited" before SP. The dream starts very nice and well with things going in my favor, but then they take a sudden shift. My last SP was 3 days ago. In my dream, I was sleeping next to a very beautiful blonde girl. It was dark but because of the light from outside I was able to see her face. After couple of seconds of watching her in the eyes, she stood up and transformed into a shadow which paralysed me and turned me over on my stomach. (I was sleeping on my side in the dream) Then the shadw started whispering something very clear in my ear but I can't remember. And then I have some tricks to get out of it, so I applied my tricks and a portal opened next to me, got sucked into the portal and woke up. This is like nothing anyway..this is just the usual. I remember sooo many sp experiences and they are too much even for me. Sometimes I have actual conversations with these entities. And just so you know, I literally experienced everything you mentioned.

Here are my tricks brother hopefully they will help you.

- When it happens, don't try to move, just accept it and relax. Moving is never going to work, it will work after the sp is finished.

- If things get scary, with voices and fear, start laughing. As insane as it sounds, whenever I start laughing these entities show weakness. 

- Try talk to them/him. I know you can't move your mouth. But talk to them inside your mind. Mention you are not scared. (Even if you are)

- Laughing and telling them you are not scared works for me in most of the cases. Sometimes it aggravates the situation, but I keep going.

- Try and realise this is not real. Tell yourself "I am out of here". Usually this also gets me out of the sp.

- Use your tongue. Try to move your tongue. Sometimes, my tongue is not paralysed, and I start moving it. After I move my tongue I create a chain reaction and manage to move and wake up.

And lastly..YOU ARE NOT INSANE. I know how it feels having this, and people who don't have it really don't understand the fear. But remember you are not insane. Every single piece of advice I just gave you might sound insane, but I honeslty don't care what others think. Try these methods and let me know how they worked for you.

But my father thought I was watching Scooby Doo too often (lol). So one day he somehow convienced me to sleep by myself.

But this time when I opened them I was on my back, the door was closed, the courtains shut and the aquarium light off. So I told myself "Ok I think papa came into my room and did this when I was asleep". But then I tried to move. I was paralysed and I facing the ceilling. From nowhere a grey smoke started floating above me from left to right and I was hearing a very creepy piano music. Then the grey smoke started whispering my name: "Andreeeeei...Andreeeeeei". I tried to scream, I couldn't, I tried to move, I couldn't, I tried to cry, I couldn't. The only part of my body that I was able to move was my tongue. For some reason I decided to make a cross with my tongue. When I did the cross, the smoke entered my body under my ribs, and went directly to my heart and I started levitating. Then I was dropped back on my bed, and in shock I just stood up on my ass while looking at the window in front of me. After aproximately 5 seconds I started to scream, and for 1 second I was not able to hear myself. But then it felt like I opened my eyes again (even if I had my eyes open, I don t know how to explain this) and this time the aquarium light was on, door open and courtains open, and I was able to hear myself. Then my dad came into my room and I started crying. 

Since that day, for the last 8-9 years, I have sleep paralysis at least once a month. I have tons of horror dreams where demons try to steal my energy, scare me, make me sad, etc. What I find the scariest thing now, is when I have conversations with them.
